integrity: The construction reuses the cited numerical map, and all theorem statements follow from explicitly derived finite-dimensional spectral formulas. Computational checks supplement, but cannot replace, the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic and the stated uniform directed-cycle Lindblad family; results neither describe arbitrary generators nor any adaptive or compressed implementation. The novelty comparison leaves room for unindexed equivalent results.
title: Dimension-sharp mixing slowdown in a trace-preserving exponential Lindblad step
